challenge.name: The Heatwave Blind Spot
challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has shifted demand for seasonal articles, and the current forecast is missing the mark. #model_monica# wants to automate the evaluation harness to test new weather features rapidly, while #requirements_reuben# wants to keep it manual to ensure every test case is rigorously documented before any model change is considered.

output.content: The current heatwave has exposed a critical gap in how we test seasonal demand shifts. We need to automate the evaluation harness to rapidly validate new weather features against live point of sale data. Right now, running a single experiment takes days of manual setup, which is far too slow for a model that must adapt to sudden demand spikes. I want to build a pipeline where any new feature is tested against historical anomalies within minutes. The more iterations we can run, the better the forecast accuracy becomes for middle aisle promotions. Speed is the only way to keep the replenishment suggestions relevant when the weather changes overnight.
output.reclassify_reason: The text emphasizes that speed and high iteration rates directly improve forecast accuracy and relevance, indicating that doing more than the minimum (faster, more frequent testing) would make the author happier.
